retention.subtitle: How long each kind of record is kept, why, and what has been erased.
retention.modeLiveHelp: The nightly job permanently deletes records once they pass the periods below.
retention.modePreview: Preview only — nothing is being deleted
retention.modePreviewHelp: The nightly job works out what is due and records it, but deletes nothing until this is turned on.
retention.enableConfirmBody: The next run will permanently delete {count} records and the files behind them. This cannot be undone. Review the list below first.
retention.nothingDue: Nothing has passed its retention period.
retention.heldNoEndDate: tenants whose last tenancy has no end date

clock.inventory_photos: the day the PDF report is generated

basis.identity_documents: Home Office, Landlord's guide to right to rent checks (26 June 2025): copies must be retained for the duration of the tenancy and at least one year thereafter, and "must then be securely destroyed".
basis.tenancy_records: Limitation Act 1980 s.5 — six years to bring a claim on a simple contract. HMRC requires business records for five years after the 31 January filing deadline, which falls inside the same window.
basis.inventory_photos: No statutory period. The report preserves the visual record, so the originals stop being necessary once it exists — UK GDPR Article 5(1)(e).
